Description: Production batch identifier (BCH-XXXX); ~2000 unique values, intentionally reused across records
Manufacturing line: Line 1, Line 2, or Line 3
Raw material supplier name; intentionally inconsistent casing/spelling for cleaning challenge
Product type: Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder, Coriander Powder, or Garam Masala
Weight of raw material input; 200-2000 for kg, 200000-2000000 for grams
Processing machine temperature in °C [50-110]; ~3% values missing (NaN)
Total production batch time in minutes [10-90]
Quality grade of incoming raw material: Grade A (40%), B (35%), C (20%), D (5%)
Weight of finished product after processing; same unit as Raw_Material_Weight; conversion factor 0.80-0.95
Final QC result: PASS or FAIL. Determined by logistic model of risk factors (moisture, temperature, speed, time, grade). Target ~25-30% FAIL rate
